findings.title: Stale-render test checks rendered text only, not buildTree input or duplicate-key warning
findings.evidence: FileBrowserRegion.test.tsx third test asserts Loading is shown and 'root-file.txt' absent while the docs listing is pending; no console.error spy and no check of the buildTree argument. FileBrowserRegion.tsx line 356 guard is unchanged by the diff.
findings.consequence: Removing the entriesFolder === contextFolder guard in buildTree while keeping the Loading branch would not fail the new tests.
findings.minimal_fix: Spy on console.error during the pending window and assert no 'same key' warning appears.

findings.title: Fails-on-old-order property not demonstrated by runner evidence
findings.evidence: The runner ran only the reviewed commit; 03-verification+gate.txt shows all 92 tests passing with the fix. The pre-change run is not in the evidence.
findings.consequence: The scope requirement that the new test fails on the current render order is judged by reading, not by execution. By inspection, the old order would leave test 1 on Loading and its findByRole('alert') would time out.
findings.minimal_fix: None needed; optionally run the new test file against the parent commit to confirm.
